svg.title: Glasswing Station detailed game-system design
svg.desc: A fictional one-page design for a cooperative orbital greenhouse game. Six linked subsystems show a shift from forecast through harvest, including oxygen and power flows, a conditional solar-flare branch, failure recovery, rules, a numeric trace, and open decisions.

g.text: Fictional cooperative systems design - stabilize an orbital greenhouse across a 12-minute shift
Scope: one complete shift and recovery loop

text.tspan: 1. Assume P 4, Air 4, Water 4, Trust 2, Stress 0;

g.text: Result: 3 more score is required for target 7.

text.tspan: 2. Scrub: Power 1 - 2 = -1. Scrub does not finish;
6. The shift continues. Failure reduces score;
Experience: coordinate scarce time, announce tradeoffs,
Win: score 7+ and Air 2+ when the 12-minute
Loss: score below 7 or Air below 2.
Keep modules and repeat the tier.
OPEN-01: Is a 30-second restart costly enough

g.text: OPEN-02: Should 3 excess Food convert to 1 Trust?

text.tspan: OPEN-03: Can a solo player assign 2 roles
PLAYTEST: Can first-time teams predict the flare

g.text: Open decisions are not confirmed rules.
